findings.description: Post-exit _drain_output uses unbounded BufferedReader.read() and blocking os.read(fd,1), without a wall deadline. A leader spawning a bounded .6s inherited-pipe child returned completed after .645s for a .1s timeout. Use bounded nonblocking/concurrent two-pipe reads and enforce the same monotonic deadline during drain; avoid unbounded allocation.

Injected killpg PermissionError followed by leader kill returns tree_cleanup_confirmed=true. Preserve false/unknown when group termination is denied or otherwise not confirmed; leader exit is insufficient proof.

Injected _drive_process RuntimeError returns environment_failure while its started leader remains alive. Outer run process variable is never assigned; _run_process finally only closes pipes. Terminate/reap started processes on every execution exception; reviewer explicitly killed/reaped probe leader.
Popen still uses preexec_fn=os.setpgrp, explicitly prohibited by the frozen contract. Replace with safe start_new_session/process_group mechanism.

64 stdout bytes at budget64 plus stderr EOF while leader sleeps .1s returns output_limit/truncated and kills leader without observing any excess byte. Detect a real extra byte, distinguish EOF, and allow exact-budget completion.

Windows path still relies exclusively on select.select of pipe descriptors; swallowed non-socket errors leave pipes unread. Simulated select OSError with require_tree_cleanup=False and bounded 200KB writer returned timed_out with empty captured output. Implement an actually working pipe-consumption path with bounded memory and deadline/cancellation; native Windows remains unrun.
Strict parser accepts declared exit_code=False as integer zero and returns completed. Reject bool explicitly for exit_code and every schema integer field; add meaningful regression coverage.

Report claims all fixes and unit-test updates although no unit files changed; cleanup, Windows path, safe spawn, drain and exact-budget failures remain reproducible. Correct claims/counts after fixes; retain explicit native Windows unrun limitation.

summary: All seven required checks pass (unit86/full182/external57+15); independent failure probes and static review establish unfulfilled frozen requirements. Scope passes:3 files,215 additions+97 deletions=312/1800. Return once for consolidated fixes; native Windows unrun.
